#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main()
{
	string s;
	cin >> s;
	string ans = "";
	int p = 0;
	bool good = false;
	for (char c : s)
	{
		if (c == 't' && p != s.length() - 1)
		{
			if (p >= 2 && ans[p - 1] == 'a' && !good)
			{
				p--;
				ans[p] = '@';
				good = true;
			}
			else if (p >= 3 && ans[p - 2] == 'd' && ans[p - 1] == 'o')
			{
				p -= 2;
				ans[p] = '.';
			}
			else
				ans[p++] = c;
		}
		else
			ans[p++] = c;
	}
	cout << ans << endl;
	return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
